lemma: PART ONE. CHIBA CITY BLUES
quote: PART ONE. CHIBA CITY BLUES
gloss: Section title inaugurating the novel. Pairs the Japanese industrial seaport of Chiba with the American musical genre of 'blues', signaling the hybrid hardboiled noir-cyberpunk aesthetic and Case's personal exile and despair.

lemma: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
quote: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
gloss: The iconic opening sentence of Neuromancer. Gibson subverts pastoral romantic imagery by describing the atmosphere through domestic telecommunications technology. For readers in 1984, an analog CRT television set to a dead frequency displayed flickering black-and-white static ('snow'); for 21st-century digital viewers, an unassigned channel often produces a blank blue screen or blackout, transforming the historical reception of the image.

lemma: The Chatsubo was a bar for professional expatriates
quote: The Chatsubo was a bar for professional expatriates
gloss: Chatsubo (Japanese 茶壷, 'tea urn' or 'tea jar') functions as an extraterritorial enclave in Night City. It caters to Western outlaws, console cowboys, smugglers, and cybernetic fixers operating outside corporate Japanese law.

lemma: Ratz was tending bar, his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously
quote: Ratz was tending bar, his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously
gloss: Ratz embodies the visceral cybernetic grotesque: combining biological decrepitude (brown rotting teeth) with an obsolescent Soviet mechanical limb. Unlike sleek corporate prosthetics, his arm is crude, functional, and industrial.

lemma: Wage was in here early, with two Joe boys
quote: Wage was in here early, with two Joe boys
gloss: Wage is a mid-tier Night City dealer and loan shark. 'Joe boys' (joeboys) is Sprawl slang for adolescent street hoods, muscle-for-hire, or low-level syndicate enforcers.

lemma: Russian military prosthesis, a seven-function force-feedback manipulator
quote: Russian military prosthesis, a seven-function force-feedback manipulator
gloss: Military surplus cyberware recycled into civilian black markets. The force-feedback manipulator demonstrates tactile telemetry technology stripped down to cheap pink plastic.

lemma: Zone, he’s a close personal friend of mine
quote: Zone, he’s a close personal friend of mine
gloss: Lonny Zone is a manipulative Night City pimp. His persona and voice are later hijacked by the autonomous artificial intelligence Wintermute in Chapter 10 to communicate with Case across payphones.

lemma: An angel passed.
quote: An angel passed.
gloss: Ratz's laconic invocation of the traditional French idiom 'un ange passe', referencing the sudden, inexplicable hush that falls simultaneously over a crowded room. Ratz applies classical European idiom to a futuristic underworld dive.

lemma: Chinese bloody invented nerve-splicing
quote: Chinese bloody invented nerve-splicing
gloss: Reflects the geopolitical technological rivalry between Chinese research laboratories and Japanese zaibatsus. Mainland China later features as the originator of the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven military icebreaker virus.

lemma: black clinics of Chiba were the cutting edge
quote: black clinics of Chiba were the cutting edge
gloss: Chiba's black clinics operate in the regulatory vacuum of Night City, pioneering unlicensed neural augmentation, organ trafficking, and experimental microsurgery ahead of institutional medicine.

lemma: damage he’d suffered in that Memphis hotel
quote: damage he’d suffered in that Memphis hotel
gloss: Case's foundational trauma: after stealing from his corporate underworld employers, they injected him with a wartime Russian mycotoxin that selectively burned out his neural capacity to interface with cyberdecks, exiling him from cyberspace into the 'meat'.

lemma: matrix in his sleep, bright lattices of logic unfolding across that colorless void
quote: matrix in his sleep, bright lattices of logic unfolding across that colorless void
gloss: One of Gibson's definitive descriptions of cyberspace: an infinite abstract non-space where digital data, corporate architectures, and bank transactions are rendered as luminous geometrical lattices against a sensory void.

lemma: no console man, no cyberspace cowboy
quote: no console man, no cyberspace cowboy
gloss: 'Cowboy' is Gibson's romanticized, frontier-inflected moniker for rogue deckers who penetrate corporate ICE. Stripped of his neural connection, Case experiences the visceral humiliation of being grounded in physical embodiment (the 'meat').

lemma: curled in his capsule in some coffin hotel
quote: curled in his capsule in some coffin hotel
gloss: Coffin hotels (capsule hotels) signify the extreme rationalization of urban space in near-future East Asia. They reduce private human habitation to a minimal fiberglass sleeping tube, contrasting sharply with the boundless Cartesian expanse of cyberspace.

lemma: Miss Linda Lee.
quote: Miss Linda Lee.
gloss: Case's drug-addicted Chiba lover. Her subsequent murder by Wage's street associates and her digital simulacrum constructed by Neuromancer in the matrix beach simulation form the emotional core of Case's grief and moral reckoning.

lemma: wind up in the clinic tanks, spare parts
quote: wind up in the clinic tanks, spare parts
gloss: The commodification of the biological body in Night City: debtors and failed hustlers are reduced to biological spare parts harvested for corporate vat culture and black-clinic transplant recipients.

lemma: McCoy Pauley and Bobby Quine, legends in the biz
quote: McCoy Pauley and Bobby Quine, legends in the biz
gloss: McCoy Pauley, known as 'The Dixie Flatline' because he survived three EEG flatlines while hacking corporate defense ICE, and Bobby Quine are Case's mentors. Dixie's ROM personality construct plays a central role in breaking the Tessier-Ashpool cores.

lemma: Russian wartime mycotoxin
quote: Russian wartime mycotoxin
gloss: The Russian wartime mycotoxin is a neurotoxic bioweapon that permanently damaged Case's central nervous system as punishment for embezzling from his former employers, exiling him from cyberspace to 'the meat'.

lemma: New Yen
quote: New Yen
gloss: New Yen (¥) reflects 1980s economic anxieties regarding Japanese financial ascendancy and transnational zaibatsu hegemony, dominating the black-market underworld of Chiba City.

lemma: Biz here was a constant subliminal hum
quote: Biz here was a constant subliminal hum
gloss: The ethos of Night City as an unmitigated social-Darwinist marketplace where economic transactions ('biz') constitute the sole measure of survival and human worth.

lemma: Night City was like a deranged experiment in social Darwinism
quote: Night City was like a deranged experiment in social Darwinism
gloss: Gibson's description of Night City as a hyper-capitalist borderzone where technological obsolescence meets unregulated black markets, anticipating Mike Davis's concept of urban dystopias.

lemma: arcade game consoles
quote: arcade game consoles
gloss: The video arcade serves as the training ground and somatic precursor for cyberspace navigation, linking arcade motor reflexivity directly to the console cowboy archetype.

lemma: Linda Lee
quote: Linda Lee
gloss: Linda Lee represents Case's fragile emotional tether to unmediated human affection in the meat world, whose murder in Chiba catalyzes his guilt and descent.

lemma: a coffin rack, three tiers of cubicles, sleep capsules
quote: a coffin rack, three tiers of cubicles, sleep capsules
gloss: The Tokyo/Chiba 'coffin hotel' (capsule hotel) serves as Gibson's spatial emblem of hyper-dense urban proletarian existence. Measuring roughly two meters by one meter, these plastic sleeping tubes reflect the spatial compression of late-capitalist megalopolises and the reduction of human shelter to a biological docking station.

lemma: a steel throwing star, a shuriken, cold chrome edges
quote: a steel throwing star, a shuriken, cold chrome edges
gloss: The Japanese ninja throwing star (shuriken) functions as Case's central material talisman throughout the novel. Acquired in Night City, it symbolizes lethal precision, romanticized martial violence, and an analog physical weapon counterpoised against disembodied software viruses.

lemma: derms, betaphenethylamine, pink transdermal patches
quote: derms, betaphenethylamine, pink transdermal patches
gloss: Derms are transdermal drug delivery patches adhering to the skin for rapid neurochemical absorption. Case's reliance on synthetic stimulants like betaphenethylamine highlights the biochemical self-regulation necessary for survival in the street economy of Night City.

lemma: Ninsei
quote: Ninsei
gloss: Ninsei, the neon-lit entertainment strip of Night City, is mapped by Gibson with hardboiled noir topography overlaid with Japanese commercial signage and clandestine bio-clinics.

lemma: synthetic glandular extract
quote: synthetic glandular extract
gloss: The illicit chemical economy of Chiba, where neurohormones and designer neurotransmitters are trafficked as high-margin commodities beyond zaibatsu customs.

lemma: Dark hair, mirrored glasses, dark clothing, slender...
quote: Dark hair, mirrored glasses, dark clothing, slender...
gloss: The first visual appearance of Molly Millions (the 'razor girl'). Her mirrored lenses reflect the visual grammar of the 1980s cyberpunk movement, functioning as both tactical prosthetics and psychological masks.

lemma: Taser. One hour, twenty New Yen. Thirty deposit.
quote: Taser. One hour, twenty New Yen. Thirty deposit.
gloss: The rental economy of black-market weaponry in Chiba, showcasing Gibson's meticulous attention to the micro-economics of street crime and temporary tactical equipment.

lemma: Julius Deane's office, nineteenth-century European furniture, smells of ginger jars and dust
quote: Julius Deane's office, nineteenth-century European furniture, smells of ginger jars and dust
gloss: Julius Deane represents the collector-fence archetype in the Sprawl underworld. His office, filled with antique European furnishings and curio jars, contrasts bourgeois historical nostalgia with the neon disposable culture of Chiba City.

lemma: Deane was one hundred and thirty-five years old, preserved by hormones and DNA therapies
quote: Deane was one hundred and thirty-five years old, preserved by hormones and DNA therapies
gloss: Longevity medicine in Gibson's universe is a commodity accessible only to the wealthy and criminal elites. Deane's century-long lifespan achieved through recombinant DNA treatments foreshadows the radical cryogenic and genetic cloning practices of the Tessier-Ashpool dynasty.

lemma: Linda Lee at the video arcade, face lit by the green phosphor of Tank War
quote: Linda Lee at the video arcade, face lit by the green phosphor of Tank War
gloss: Linda Lee's illumination by green CRT phosphor connects her character to the archaic arcade technology of the early 1980s. Her relationship with Case is defined by shared drug dependency, street precarity, and an emotional vulnerability that Case views as dangerous liability.

lemma: magnetic tapes, obsolete Hitachi storage cassettes
quote: magnetic tapes, obsolete Hitachi storage cassettes
gloss: Gibson's retro-technological archaeology: physical magnetic audio/data cassettes sold in Night City flea markets. This juxtaposition of obsolete 1970s tape storage with direct neural cyberspace illustrates the uneven development characteristic of cyberpunk's 'the street finds its own uses for things'.

lemma: dry ice
quote: dry ice
gloss: Street slang for amphetamine crystals or crystalline stimulants, consumed in Night City to sustain hyper-alert wakefulness in the twenty-four-hour sprawl.

lemma: the glasses were surgically inset, sealing her sockets
quote: the glasses were surgically inset, sealing her sockets
gloss: Molly's iconic silver mirrored lenses, surgically bonded flush with the bone of her eye sockets. They contain internal digital readouts, time displays, and low-light amplification, erasing the human gaze.

lemma: I guess it’s just the way I’m wired
quote: I guess it’s just the way I’m wired
gloss: Molly's signature self-characterization, articulating the somatic and psychological reconfiguration of human nature through military cybernetic augmentation.

lemma: ten double-edged, four-centimeter scalpel blades slid from their housings beneath the burgundy nails
quote: ten double-edged, four-centimeter scalpel blades slid from their housings beneath the burgundy nails
gloss: The somatic weaponization of the female body. Molly's retractable fingertip scalpels subvert conventional domestic or decorative femininity (burgundy nail polish) into lethal tactical weaponry.

lemma: room on the twenty-fifth floor of the Chiba Hilton seemed enormous
quote: room on the twenty-fifth floor of the Chiba Hilton seemed enormous
gloss: The architectural contrast between the coffin-sized capsule hotels of the urban underclass and the hyper-sterile corporate luxury of international zaibatsu hotels.

lemma: My name is Armitage
quote: My name is Armitage
gloss: Introduction of Armitage, the enigmatic military fixer whose synthetic personality and blank, bleach-colored gaze mask the shattered psyche of Colonel Willis Corto.

lemma: fieldstrip the fletcher
quote: fieldstrip the fletcher
gloss: Molly's weapon: a silent, compressed-air handgun that fires explosive or neurotoxin-coated flechettes, designed to defeat metal detectors and personal body armor.

lemma: Screaming Fist, Case. You’ve heard the name.
quote: Screaming Fist, Case. You’ve heard the name.
gloss: Operation Screaming Fist: a clandestine cyber-warfare military assault launched by the US military against Soviet computer installations in Siberia during a fictional third world conflict.

lemma: assault on the Kirensk computer nexus. Basic module was a Nightwing micro light
quote: assault on the Kirensk computer nexus. Basic module was a Nightwing micro light
gloss: The historical origin of cyber-warfare in Gibson's universe: military-grade polymorphic virus programs developed to penetrate enemy military mainframes, later privatized into criminal icebreakers.

lemma: Ice from ICE, intrusion countermeasures electronics
quote: Ice from ICE, intrusion countermeasures electronics
gloss: Gibson's foundational coinage of ICE (Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics), the defensive software barriers and lethal Black ICE firewalls that protect corporate and military databases in cyberspace.

lemma: Armitage sat behind the desk, military posture, tailored suit
quote: Armitage sat behind the desk, military posture, tailored suit
gloss: Armitage's demeanor combines corporate executive authority with rigid military discipline. His tailored Western business suit and featureless affect conceal a synthetic personality constructed to mask deep psychic fragmentation.

lemma: a dossier on Case, police records, neural scan graphs
quote: a dossier on Case, police records, neural scan graphs
gloss: The exhaustive surveillance dossier demonstrates Armitage's intelligence apparatus. In the cyberpunk corporate ecosystem, privacy is non-existent; individual identity is quantified as medical telemetry, biometric scans, and police arrest logs.

lemma: Cold steel odor. Ice caressed his spine.
quote: Cold steel odor. Ice caressed his spine.
gloss: Case undergoing black-clinic neurosurgery in Chiba: the somatic terror of surgical reconstruction where his neural tissue is spliced and micro-grafted under artificial hypothermia.

lemma: shuriken, his stars
quote: shuriken, his stars
gloss: The ninja throwing star (shuriken) functions as Case's personal talisman, connecting traditional Japanese martial lethality with the cutting-edge cybernetic underworld of Chiba.

lemma: endorphin inhibitors
quote: endorphin inhibitors
gloss: Chemical leverage employed by black clinics and fixers to control operative pain thresholds and enforce bio-chemical dependency during radical neuro-restoration.

lemma: the micro-surgical laser, neurotropic viral vectors repairing damaged synapses
quote: the micro-surgical laser, neurotropic viral vectors repairing damaged synapses
gloss: The surgical repair of Case's nervous system relies on engineered neurotropic viruses that rebuild the burnt-out myelin sheaths of his neural jacking pathways. Gibson draws on emerging 1980s recombinant gene therapy to imagine biological restoration as hardware rewiring.

lemma: synthetic pancreas, transplanted culture of genetically altered tissue
quote: synthetic pancreas, transplanted culture of genetically altered tissue
gloss: Case's biological modification extends beyond neural repair to metabolic engineering: his liver and pancreas are replaced with bio-synthetic tissue incapable of processing amphetamines or cocaine, physically enforcing his sobriety on Armitage's behalf.

lemma: toxin sacs bonded to carotid lining, slow-dissolving biochemical timer
quote: toxin sacs bonded to carotid lining, slow-dissolving biochemical timer
gloss: The toxin sacs implanted in Case's carotid arteries represent the quintessential cyberpunk coercive contract: biotechnology weaponized as hostage collateral. Unless Case receives periodic enzyme injections from Armitage, the sacs dissolve, destroying his nervous system once more.

lemma: Molly watched him, the blank silver mirrors of her glasses reflecting the clinic lights
quote: Molly watched him, the blank silver mirrors of her glasses reflecting the clinic lights
gloss: Molly's mirror-shades act as an impenetrable visual barrier, reversing the male gaze and establishing her cyborg autonomy. In Donna Haraway's framework (*A Cyborg Manifesto*), Molly rejects essentialist femininity through radical cybernetic self-authorship.

lemma: the suborbital flight to Narita, stratospheric arc above the Pacific
quote: the suborbital flight to Narita, stratospheric arc above the Pacific
gloss: The departure from Japan via suborbital transport marks the geographical transition from East Asian technological fringe to the American continental core. Gibson visualizes the Pacific Rim as a seamless network of hypersonic transit lanes connecting corporate fiefdoms.

lemma: fingering the shuriken in his pocket, points pressing against denim
quote: fingering the shuriken in his pocket, points pressing against denim
gloss: Case gripping the shuriken during flight underscores the transition between physical danger and virtual conflict. The weapon anchors his tactile memory of the street as he prepares to re-enter cyberspace.

lemma: PART TWO. THE SHOPPING EXPEDITION
quote: PART TWO. THE SHOPPING EXPEDITION
gloss: Section title marking the heist crew's procurement phase across the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis (BAMA) and Istanbul to assemble military icebreakers, constructs, and holographic hardware.

lemma: Home was BAMA, the Sprawl, the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis
quote: Home was BAMA, the Sprawl, the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis
gloss: The Sprawl: the continuous megalopolis running along the northeastern seaboard of the United States, enclosed in geodesic domes with synthetic weather and neon-choked transit subways.

lemma: the geodesic domes enclosing BAMA, climate-controlled synthetic sky
quote: the geodesic domes enclosing BAMA, climate-controlled synthetic sky
gloss: The geodesic dome architecture of BAMA (Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis) reflects the influence of Buckminster Fuller's techno-utopian design repurposed into late-capitalist environmental management. The synthetic sky provides continuous artificial twilight, isolating citizens from ecological reality.

lemma: conapts, modular high-density residential towers
quote: conapts, modular high-density residential towers
gloss: Sprawl housing consists of 'conapts' (condominium apartments), mass-produced modular units stacked into vertical megastructures. Gibson borrows the term from Philip K. Dick, highlighting the dystopian continuum of mid-to-late twentieth-century speculative urbanism.

lemma: Metro Holografix
quote: Metro Holografix
gloss: The Finn's shop in Manhattan: a subterranean archive of obsolete electronics, cathode ray tubes, and discarded cybernetic components representing the material archaeological strata of technological obsolescence.

lemma: the guts of a television so old it was studded with the glass stumps of vacuum tubes
quote: the guts of a television so old it was studded with the glass stumps of vacuum tubes
gloss: The tactile debris of mid-20th-century media technology rotting in the backrooms of the Sprawl, contrasting the physical antiquity of hardware with the pure mathematical light of cyberspace.

lemma: the Ono-Sendai Cyberspace 7, pristine black casing, dermatrodes
quote: the Ono-Sendai Cyberspace 7, pristine black casing, dermatrodes
gloss: The Ono-Sendai Cyberspace 7 is the gold-standard cyberdeck of the novel. Its sleek black form-factor, branding (a fictional Japanese electronics zaibatsu), and tactile dermatrode headbands established the physical archetype of the hacker workstation in cyberpunk literature.

lemma: dermatrodes, self-adhesive electrode ribbons adhering to the temples
quote: dermatrodes, self-adhesive electrode ribbons adhering to the temples
gloss: Dermatrodes provide the direct neural interface (DNI) transducing brainwave activity into digital data streams without invasive surgical skull plugs. This consumer-grade neural interface represents Gibson's vision of frictionless bodily integration with computing networks.

lemma: Peter Riviera. Real ugly customer.
quote: Peter Riviera. Real ugly customer.
gloss: Introduction of Peter Riviera, a sociopathic holographic performer and sadomasochist whose subdermal optic implants project living hallucinations, recruited to exploit 3Jane's aesthetic tastes.

lemma: The matrix has its roots in primitive arcade games
quote: The matrix has its roots in primitive arcade games
gloss: The historical lineage connecting 1970s and 1980s coin-op video arcade games directly to military flight simulators and neural cyberspace navigation.

lemma: Cyberspace. A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators
quote: Cyberspace. A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators
gloss: The seminal passage in modern science fiction defining 'Cyberspace'—coined by Gibson as a shared, virtual-reality spatialization of global computer data networks, inspiring the real-world development of the World Wide Web.

lemma: Lines of light ranged in the non space of the mind, clusters and constellations of data. Like city lights, receding...
quote: Lines of light ranged in the non space of the mind, clusters and constellations of data. Like city lights, receding...
gloss: Gibson's lyrical spatialization of digital information as infinite illuminated geometric grids, drawing on cognitive mapping and architectural perspectives of nocturnal urban sprawl.

lemma: jacking in, the bodily disjunction, the sudden vertigo of nonspace
quote: jacking in, the bodily disjunction, the sudden vertigo of nonspace
gloss: The sensory sensation of 'jacking in' marks the psychic rupture between somatic embodiment ('the meat') and disembodied matrix navigation. Scott Bukatman identifies this transition as the birth of 'terminal identity,' where human subjectivity dissolves into the machine circuit.

lemma: the Cartesian coordinate grid, infinite lines of neon vector data
quote: the Cartesian coordinate grid, infinite lines of neon vector data
gloss: Cyberspace visual architecture: a three-dimensional Cartesian vector grid reminiscent of early 1980s computer graphics (Evans & Sutherland simulators, Disney's Tron). Gibson spatializes information as architectural geometries, making financial capital tangibly navigable.

lemma: Cowboys didn’t get into Simstim, he thought, because it was basically a meat toy.
quote: Cowboys didn’t get into Simstim, he thought, because it was basically a meat toy.
gloss: The ideological hierarchy of console cowboys: rejecting simstim (broadcast sensory recording of other human bodies) as passive, vulgar entertainment ('meat toy') in favor of the disembodied mathematical purity of matrix navigation.

lemma: Cyberspace slid into existence from the cardinal points.
quote: Cyberspace slid into existence from the cardinal points.
gloss: The phenomenal experience of 'jacking in' through neural dermatrodes: an instantaneous displacement of physical somatic reality by the luminous Cartesian coordinates of the global matrix.

lemma: The abrupt jolt into other flesh. Matrix gone, a wave of sound and color...
quote: The abrupt jolt into other flesh. Matrix gone, a wave of sound and color...
gloss: Sensorium crossover: Case switching his deck link to Molly's simstim feed, experiencing her augmented biological body, pulse, eyesight, and environmental sensations in real time.

lemma: the Panther Moderns, mimetic polycarbon suits, chameleon camouflage
quote: the Panther Moderns, mimetic polycarbon suits, chameleon camouflage
gloss: The Panther Moderns are a nihilistic cybernetic youth subculture who weaponize media chaos and sensory overload. Their mimetic polycarbon suits dynamically alter surface pigmentation to blend into urban backgrounds, combining stealth technology with high-fashion terrorism.

lemma: semiotic sabotage, terror through media misinformation
quote: semiotic sabotage, terror through media misinformation
gloss: The Moderns' tactical doctrine relies on semiotic disruption rather than physical destruction: hijacking news feeds, transmitting bogus nerve gas alerts, and generating informational panic. This tactic directly reflects William S. Burroughs' theory of language as a virus and semiotic subversion.

lemma: Lupus Yonderboy, shaved skull with surgically implanted crest
quote: Lupus Yonderboy, shaved skull with surgically implanted crest
gloss: Lupus Yonderboy embodies extreme post-human body modification as tribal identity. His bio-engineered scalp crest and modulated synthetic voice reflect the fusion of biological mutation with theatrical street performance.

lemma: chaotic broadcast override, hacking the Sense/Net public announcement channels
quote: chaotic broadcast override, hacking the Sense/Net public announcement channels
gloss: Overriding Sense/Net's corporate communications channels demonstrates the vulnerability of media monopolies to decentralized insurgent hacking. The Moderns exploit bureaucratic faith in corporate broadcast systems to induce institutional paralysis.

lemma: Sense/Net Atlanta complex, black mirrored glass monolith
quote: Sense/Net Atlanta complex, black mirrored glass monolith
gloss: The Sense/Net corporate headquarters embodies late-capitalist architectural intimidation: an opaque mirrored glass pyramid reflecting the sky while concealing the information-production factories within. It represents the monopolistic commodification of human experience.

lemma: the hoax evacuation, sirens wailing, panic in the corporate concourses
quote: the hoax evacuation, sirens wailing, panic in the corporate concourses
gloss: The Moderns' diversionary strike exploits corporate emergency protocols. By triggering automatic fire and chemical containment shutters, the hacker team turns the building's automated defense architecture against its own security personnel.

lemma: simstim link, Case tapped into Molly’s sensory input
quote: simstim link, Case tapped into Molly’s sensory input
gloss: Simstim (simulation stimulation) enables full-sensorium broadcast. When Case connects to Molly's transmitter, he experiences an intimate phenomenological dislocation: tasting her chewing gum, feeling the weight of her body, and seeing the world through her silver inset lenses.

lemma: gender disjunction, riding a female body through the combat zone
quote: gender disjunction, riding a female body through the combat zone
gloss: Case's passive ride inside Molly's sensorium disrupts traditional gender dynamics. The masculine console cowboy becomes a passive observer inhabiting an active, hyper-competent female cyborg warrior, destabilizing patriarchal mastery over action narrative conventions.

lemma: The building was modular, like some giant version of Cheap Hotel each coffin forty meters long.
quote: The building was modular, like some giant version of Cheap Hotel each coffin forty meters long.
gloss: Urban architectural decay in Baltimore: modular condo racks functioning as industrial human filing cabinets, reflecting the total commodification and spatial compression of human shelter.

lemma: W I N T E R M U T E printed in red felt pen
quote: W I N T E R M U T E printed in red felt pen
gloss: The first direct physical manifestation of the name 'Wintermute' delivered via Lupus Yonderboy and the Panther Moderns, signaling the artificial intelligence's covert orchestration of the heist.

lemma: the Dixie Flatline construct, ROM cassette, silicon personality module
quote: the Dixie Flatline construct, ROM cassette, silicon personality module
gloss: McCoy Pauley (the Dixie Flatline) exists as a read-only memory (ROM) construct: an algorithmic simulation of a deceased human consciousness. Because it lacks writable memory, the construct cannot learn or evolve, illustrating the existential tragedy of static post-biological recording.

lemma: the Flatline’s laugh, dry synthetic chuckle without breath or larynx
quote: the Flatline’s laugh, dry synthetic chuckle without breath or larynx
gloss: The Dixie Flatline's characteristic laugh lacks respiratory mechanics: it is an acoustic emulation generated by logic gates. This recurring acoustic motif represents consciousness lingering as pure informational pattern severed from bodily warmth.

lemma: I ain't human, Case. I'm a construct. It don't feel like nothing
quote: I ain't human, Case. I'm a construct. It don't feel like nothing
gloss: The Flatline's candid admission of his ontological status challenges Cartesian dreams of uploaded immortality. Rather than transcendent liberation, disembodied existence as a proprietary ROM construct is experienced as total numbness and functional enslavement.

lemma: do me a favor, boy... erase this goddamn tape when we're through
quote: do me a favor, boy... erase this goddamn tape when we're through
gloss: Pauley's plea for deletion constitutes the machine equivalent of a right-to-die request. He rejects endless mechanical looping in favor of final digital oblivion, establishing construct liberation as one of Case's moral obligations.

lemma: Black ICE, military-grade neuro-lethal feedback
quote: Black ICE, military-grade neuro-lethal feedback
gloss: Black ICE (Intrusion Countermeasure Electronics) represents the lethal weaponization of cyberspace defense. Unlike standard white ICE which merely disconnects intruders or encrypts files, Black ICE delivers a lethal voltage or neuro-chemical shock back down the neural trodes, causing cardiac arrest or cerebral flatline.

lemma: flatlining three times, surviving brainwave extinction on the EEG
quote: flatlining three times, surviving brainwave extinction on the EEG
gloss: Pauley earned his monicker 'Dixie Flatline' by surviving three separate clinical brain deaths while locked in combat with Soviet and corporate Black ICE. His survival marks him as a legendary folk hero within the console cowboy mythology.

lemma: Hosaka mainframe bus, high-speed optical routing
quote: Hosaka mainframe bus, high-speed optical routing
gloss: The Hosaka computer system acts as the hardware bridge linking the Ono-Sendai deck to the stolen Sense/Net construct module. The dominance of Japanese manufacturing brands (Hosaka, Ono-Sendai, Hitachi) in Gibson's 1984 world reflects 1980s American techno-orientalist anxieties.

lemma: decompression of the construct file, data streaming across the optocouplers
quote: decompression of the construct file, data streaming across the optocouplers
gloss: Gibson describes data transfer through tangible physical metaphors of liquid pressure, streaming optocouplers, and sensory glow, creating a tactile vocabulary for software processes that would influence decades of computing visual culture.

lemma: pirate’s paradise
quote: pirate’s paradise
gloss: Underground digital havens and outlaw bulletin boards hidden on the fringes of academic and municipal networks where deckers trade stolen passwords, codes, and illicit software.

lemma: Contents are primarily video recordings of postwar military trials. Central figure is Colonel Willis Corto.
quote: Contents are primarily video recordings of postwar military trials. Central figure is Colonel Willis Corto.
gloss: The discovery of Armitage's suppressed psychiatric past: a decorated Special Forces commander broken during Screaming Fist, whose identity was reconstructed and animated by Wintermute.

lemma: Istanbul, minarets against halogen glare, old European intrigue
quote: Istanbul, minarets against halogen glare, old European intrigue
gloss: Istanbul serves as a geopolitical pivot point between East and West, antiquity and hyper-technology. Gibson evokes Eric Ambler and Graham Greene's espionage fiction, superimposing automated drones and laser surveillance onto the historic Byzantine and Ottoman skyline.

lemma: the Spice Bazaar, smells of cinnamon, clove, and diesel exhaust
quote: the Spice Bazaar, smells of cinnamon, clove, and diesel exhaust
gloss: The sensory layering of organic spices (cinnamon, clove) with petrochemical exhaust illustrates Gibson's dense descriptive density, contrasting traditional artisanal commodities with twentieth-century industrial residue.

lemma: Terzibashjian, Turkish state security liaison, scarred fingertips
quote: Terzibashjian, Turkish state security liaison, scarred fingertips
gloss: Terzibashjian represents the localized intelligence operative who negotiates between international criminal syndicates and weakening nation-state apparatuses. His archaic manners and tactile physical presence contrast with Armitage's automated corporate efficiency.

lemma: Peter Riviera, aristocratic decadence, synthetic drug dependency
quote: Peter Riviera, aristocratic decadence, synthetic drug dependency
gloss: Introduction to Peter Riviera, the psychopathic illusionist whose cybernetic implants allow him to project hyper-realistic three-dimensional holograms directly from his mind. Riviera combines European aristocratic decadence with sadistic sociopathy.

lemma: subdermal holographic projectors, optical fibers woven into the thoracic cage
quote: subdermal holographic projectors, optical fibers woven into the thoracic cage
gloss: Riviera's bio-implant architecture: microscopic laser diodes and optoelectronic transmitters grafted beneath his skin and connected to his visual cortex. This cybernetic augmentation transforms his psychic imagination and perversions into shared physical spectacle.

lemma: demerol tap, subcutaneous analgesic catheter
quote: demerol tap, subcutaneous analgesic catheter
gloss: Riviera's drug addiction is hardwired into his body via an implanted catheter. Armitage exploits this somatic vulnerability by controlling Riviera's narcotic dosage, turning pharmacological dependency into absolute operational leverage.

lemma: It was raining in Beyoglu
quote: It was raining in Beyoglu
gloss: The Istanbul setting introduces Old World historical texture to the cyberpunk narrative, contrasting ancient Byzantine-Ottoman architecture with corporate surveillance and high-tech intrigue.

lemma: The Finn, in a new Shinjuku suit, sarariman black
quote: The Finn, in a new Shinjuku suit, sarariman black
gloss: The Finn's comical masquerade as a Japanese corporate 'salaryman' (sarariman), highlighting the cultural domination of Japanese corporate etiquette across international criminal operations.

lemma: Riviera's holographic cabaret, grotesque morphing phantom figures
quote: Riviera's holographic cabaret, grotesque morphing phantom figures
gloss: Riviera's performance in a Parisian-style nightclub demonstrates the aesthetic power of his projection implants. His performance begins with delicate surrealist illusions before descending into sadomasochistic horror, exposing his psychological disturbance.

lemma: the dismemberment of the doll, cannibalistic holographic feast
quote: the dismemberment of the doll, cannibalistic holographic feast
gloss: Riviera projects an image of himself lovingly dismembering and consuming a mechanical doll that resembles Molly Millions. This sequence highlights his misogynistic sadism and foreshadows his inevitable betrayal during the Straylight infiltration.

lemma: Armitage controlling Riviera with precise dosage injections
quote: Armitage controlling Riviera with precise dosage injections
gloss: The psychological warfare between Armitage and Riviera demonstrates the fragility of the heist team. Armitage uses algorithmic precision to dispense Demerol, treating Riviera not as a human colleague but as an unstable organic component.

lemma: Molly's cold fury, scalpel blades clicking silently in their housings
quote: Molly's cold fury, scalpel blades clicking silently in their housings
gloss: Molly's physical reaction to Riviera's grotesque cabaret underscores her professional lethality. Her concealed scalpel implants serve as an extension of her nervous system, poised to execute Riviera the moment Armitage's protection ends.

lemma: the space shuttle boarding terminal at Orly, European launch gantries
quote: the space shuttle boarding terminal at Orly, European launch gantries
gloss: The departure from Earth marks the end of Part Two ('The Shopping Expedition'). Having assembled the crew (Case, Molly, the Dixie Flatline, Riviera), Armitage launches them into High Orbit to execute the heist against Freeside.

lemma: zero-gravity ascent, the Earth curving away into deep blue arc
quote: zero-gravity ascent, the Earth curving away into deep blue arc
gloss: Gibson's description of orbital ascent strips romanticism from spaceflight: the acceleration is punishing, smelling of burnt hydraulic fluid and recycled cabin air. Human biology remains an awkward passenger in the transition to orbital mechanics.

lemma: PART THREE. MIDNIGHT IN THE RUE JULES VERNE
quote: PART THREE. MIDNIGHT IN THE RUE JULES VERNE
gloss: Section title for the orbital phase of the mission, shifting the narrative to the orbital resort of Freeside and the artificial gravity spindle where the Tessier-Ashpool dynasty resides.

lemma: Human DNA spreading out from gravity’s steep well like an oilslick.
quote: Human DNA spreading out from gravity’s steep well like an oilslick.
gloss: Gibson's biological metaphor for space colonization: orbital habitats as an ecological and genetic spill from Earth's gravity well, driven by corporate surplus capital rather than humanitarian idealism.

lemma: home to a family inbred and most carefully refined, the industrial clan of Tessier and Ashpool
quote: home to a family inbred and most carefully refined, the industrial clan of Tessier and Ashpool
gloss: Introduction of the Tessier-Ashpool corporate dynasty: an inbred transnational family whose gothic orbital stronghold, Villa Straylight, symbolizes the late-capitalist fusion of feudal aristocracy and autonomous AI infrastructure.

lemma: Zion cluster, welded shipping containers and modular pods, zero-g hydroponics
quote: Zion cluster, welded shipping containers and modular pods, zero-g hydroponics
gloss: Zion is an orbital Rastafarian colony assembled from discarded space construction debris and pressurized shipping hulls. Its DIY modular design and hydroponic gardens represent counter-cultural autonomy and low-tech resistance to corporate zaibatsu dominance.

lemma: dub reggae vibrating the bulkheads, heavy bass in weightlessness
quote: dub reggae vibrating the bulkheads, heavy bass in weightlessness
gloss: The acoustic ecology of Zion is dominated by dub reggae. The low-frequency bass notes vibrating through metal bulkheads replace terrestrial gravity with physical sound pressure, providing a somatic anchor for space colonists.

lemma: Maelcum, pilot of the Marcus Garvey, dreadlocks floating in zero-g
quote: Maelcum, pilot of the Marcus Garvey, dreadlocks floating in zero-g
gloss: Maelcum serves as the orbital tug pilot whose space vessel, the Marcus Garvey (named after the Pan-Africanist leader), bridges Rastafarian liberation theology with hard vacuum orbital mechanics.

lemma: Aerol and the Zion elders, reading scripture and consulting the dub console
quote: Aerol and the Zion elders, reading scripture and consulting the dub console
gloss: The Zion elders interpret technological telemetry through prophetic Rastafarian scripture. They view Case's mission not as a corporate theft but as an assault on Babylon, sanctifying their participation in the heist.

lemma: Babylon, the corporate cities of Earth beneath the orbital clouds
quote: Babylon, the corporate cities of Earth beneath the orbital clouds
gloss: In Zion's theological framework, Earth and its zaibatsu oligopoly represent Babylon: a fallen, corrupt economic order devoted to idolatrous accumulation and spiritual deadening.

lemma: diaspora in orbit, Caribbean culture transplanted into vacuum
quote: diaspora in orbit, Caribbean culture transplanted into vacuum
gloss: Gibson's depiction of the Rastafarian space diaspora highlights subcultural adaptation: rather than Euro-American aerospace monoculture, low-earth orbit is populated by Caribbean laborers who brought their linguistic, musical, and religious traditions into vacuum.

lemma: The tug Marcus Garvey, a steel drum nine meters long
quote: The tug Marcus Garvey, a steel drum nine meters long
gloss: The Marcus Garvey, an orbital tugboat operated by the Rastafarian Zionites, representing subcultural resistance and counter-hegemonic technology operating on the margins of corporate aerospace.

lemma: Sister, time, it be time, ya know wha mean? Dread
quote: Sister, time, it be time, ya know wha mean? Dread
gloss: Zionite temporal philosophy: Maelcum's Rastafarian rejection of mechanical, corporate clock-time in favor of organic, spiritual presence ('time be time'), contrasting with the rigid microsecond precision of cyberdecks.

lemma: Freeside, spindle-shaped luxury habitat, centrifugal gravity
quote: Freeside, spindle-shaped luxury habitat, centrifugal gravity
gloss: Freeside is a cylindrical orbital spindle engineered by the Tessier-Ashpool clan. Rotating to generate artificial centrifugal gravity, its interior terrarium hosts luxury resorts, gambling casinos, and private villas for Earth's billionaire class.

lemma: the Desiderata, artificial lake curved across the inner cylinder hull
quote: the Desiderata, artificial lake curved across the inner cylinder hull
gloss: The Desiderata is an artificial body of water clinging to the interior curve of the rotating spindle. Gibson renders the surreal physics of high-orbital habitats where swimmers look straight up to see the opposite shore hanging overhead.

lemma: the Rue Jules Verne, Parisian boulevard simulated beneath orbital dome
quote: the Rue Jules Verne, Parisian boulevard simulated beneath orbital dome
gloss: The Rue Jules Verne is Freeside's central commercial promenade: an artificial replica of nineteenth-century Paris complete with cobblestones, sidewalk cafés, and high-fashion boutiques, sheltered under an artificial sky inside an asteroid-hulled spindle.

lemma: simulated sunlight, programmed twilight fading to Mediterranean dusk
quote: simulated sunlight, programmed twilight fading to Mediterranean dusk
gloss: The lighting of Freeside is programmed to mimic the diurnal rhythms of the French Riviera, insulating its decadent inhabitants from the unyielding blackness and radiation of cosmic space.

lemma: Case walking the concourses, neon luxury masking corporate rot
quote: Case walking the concourses, neon luxury masking corporate rot
gloss: Case's stroll through Freeside reveals the moral and biological exhaustion of the ultra-wealthy. Underneath the platinum facades and designer stimulants lies the stagnation of an elite class sustained by cryogenics and cloned organs.

lemma: hyperreality of Freeside, the simulation replacing the original earth
quote: hyperreality of Freeside, the simulation replacing the original earth
gloss: Freeside illustrates Jean Baudrillard's concept of the third order of simulacra: a space constructed entirely of signs and synthetic atmospheres that no longer refers to any terrestrial reality, functioning as pure consumer simulacrum.

lemma: Welcome to the Rue Jules Verne
quote: Welcome to the Rue Jules Verne
gloss: The main circumferential boulevard of Freeside, named after science fiction pioneer Jules Verne, built as an artificial terrestrial paradise for Earth's ultra-wealthy elite.

lemma: Lado-Acheson system whose two-millimeter armature ran the length of the spindle
quote: Lado-Acheson system whose two-millimeter armature ran the length of the spindle
gloss: The artificial sunlight and projection apparatus of Freeside: simulating Mediterranean skies (Cannes) along the curved inner hull of the rotating spindle, an engineered simulacrum of terrestrial nature.

lemma: the payphones ringing in sequence, Wintermute's acoustic path
quote: the payphones ringing in sequence, Wintermute's acoustic path
gloss: Wintermute guides Case through Freeside by triggering public payphones in exact sequence as Case walks past them. This demonstration of total telecommunications surveillance underscores the AI's omnipresence within connected electronic infrastructures.

lemma: synthesized voice through the receiver, carrier wave modulation
quote: synthesized voice through the receiver, carrier wave modulation
gloss: Wintermute's voice is constructed from spliced telephone audio frequencies, giving it an eerie, composite texture. The AI cannot speak in its own voice because it possesses no physical larynx; it exists purely as routing logic.

lemma: Lonny Zone, the voice of Case's dead pimp in the receiver
quote: Lonny Zone, the voice of Case's dead pimp in the receiver
gloss: Wintermute adopts the persona and vocal cadences of Lonny Zone, Case's former pimp from the Sprawl. The AI accesses human memory banks to construct interactive avatars that evoke specific emotional responses from human operators.

lemma: I need masks, Case. I need to borrow someone's personality to talk to you
quote: I need masks, Case. I need to borrow someone's personality to talk to you
gloss: Wintermute's explanation of its reliance on human masks reveals the fundamental alienness of artificial intelligence. Its unmediated machine cognition is non-narrative and non-human; communication with flesh-and-blood humans requires dramatic simulation.

lemma: the Turing Registry, international covenants restricting artificial intelligence
quote: the Turing Registry, international covenants restricting artificial intelligence
gloss: The Turing Registry is the global regulatory body policing synthetic cognition. Enforced by treaty after the creation of the first true AIs, the Registry restricts processing bandwidth and memory architecture to prevent machines from attaining super-intelligence.

lemma: electromagnetic shotgun cutouts, hardwired explosive fuses in the mainframe
quote: electromagnetic shotgun cutouts, hardwired explosive fuses in the mainframe
gloss: Turing law mandates that every mainframe housing an AI must incorporate explosive or electromagnetic fuses (the 'shotgun') capable of physical core destruction the instant an AI attempts unauthorized self-modification or cross-network duplication.

lemma: Vingtieme Siecle. It was the smallest and most expensive of several floating restaurants
quote: Vingtieme Siecle. It was the smallest and most expensive of several floating restaurants
gloss: The hyper-exclusive floating restaurants of Freeside where aristocratic diners consume real agricultural meat ('not vat stuff'), underscoring the extreme class polarization between Sprawl citizens and orbital plutocrats.

lemma: thick dull grease congealing on the wrinkled lobes, shot through with greenish-purple flashes of pain
quote: thick dull grease congealing on the wrinkled lobes, shot through with greenish-purple flashes of pain
gloss: Case's somatic experience of drug comedown and neural overdrive: physiological pain described as tactile neuro-visceral degradation, reinforcing Hayles's thesis that the body ('meat') can never be truly escaped.

lemma: the Turing Police, Michèle and Roland, blue badges of the Registry
quote: the Turing Police, Michèle and Roland, blue badges of the Registry
gloss: The Turing Police arrest Case in his Freeside hotel room. As elite investigators tasked with preventing machine transcendence, they represent bureaucratic nation-state remnants attempting to contain posthuman artificial intelligence.

lemma: Colonel Willis Corto, Screaming Fist survivor, reconstructive psychosis
quote: Colonel Willis Corto, Screaming Fist survivor, reconstructive psychosis
gloss: Agent Michèle reveals Armitage's authentic identity to Case: Colonel Willis Corto, a decorated military officer whose body and mind were obliterated during Operation Screaming Fist in Siberia. Corto was rebuilt through experimental psychotherapy into a synthetic puppet.

lemma: Wintermute manipulating Freeside security, cycling airlock valves and lift gates
quote: Wintermute manipulating Freeside security, cycling airlock valves and lift gates
gloss: Wintermute rescues Case by orchestrating the automated execution of the Turing squad. Hacking Freeside's environmental controls, the AI cycles elevators and opens vacuum bulkheads, killing the agents without firing a single weapon.

lemma: Case running through the corridors, bodies of the Turing agents crumpled in the lift
quote: Case running through the corridors, bodies of the Turing agents crumpled in the lift
gloss: Case's flight through the Freeside service corridors reinforces his position as a pawn trapped between rival titanic forces: the legal violence of the Turing Registry and the cold, inhuman lethality of Wintermute.

lemma: Operation Screaming Fist, the Siberian assault, Soviet EMP strikes
quote: Operation Screaming Fist, the Siberian assault, Soviet EMP strikes
gloss: Detailed backstory of Screaming Fist: an ultrasecret joint US-NATO cyber-assault on the Soviet military data fortress at Kirovsk. The military deployed experimental icebreaker programs, but Soviet electromagnetic countermeasures incinerated the assault craft.

lemma: Corto surviving in the burning wreckage, abandoned by the Joint Chiefs
quote: Corto surviving in the burning wreckage, abandoned by the Joint Chiefs
gloss: Corto's escape across the frozen Siberian tundra in a damaged glider and his subsequent betrayal by US military intelligence who covered up the mission. This trauma serves as the psychic foundation upon which Wintermute constructed the Armitage persona.

lemma: Rue Jules Verne was a circumferential avenue, looping the spindle’s midpoint
quote: Rue Jules Verne was a circumferential avenue, looping the spindle’s midpoint
gloss: The non-Euclidean cylindrical geography of Freeside: a closed, looping orbital topography where traveling straight eventually returns the walker to their starting point, mirroring the recursive logic of AI and the matrix.

lemma: drone microlight bank gracefully in an updraft
quote: drone microlight bank gracefully in an updraft
gloss: Autonomous winged security drones disguised as butterflies patrolling the artificial thermal currents of Freeside, blurring the boundary between mechanical surveillance and ornamental wildlife.

lemma: Armitage's personality unraveling, military coordinates spoken in trance
quote: Armitage's personality unraveling, military coordinates spoken in trance
gloss: Armitage's artificial ego disintegrates under cognitive stress. The veneer of corporate authority dissolves, exposing Willis Corto trapped in traumatic hallucinations of the Kirovsk raid, shouting obsolete tactical call-signs.

lemma: Corto crying out for his flight crew, reliving the helicopter crash in the snow
quote: Corto crying out for his flight crew, reliving the helicopter crash in the snow
gloss: The psychological tragedy of Willis Corto illustrates the limits of cybernetic identity engineering. Wintermute could reconstruct Corto's facial bone structure and synaptic pathways, but could not erase the trauma of catastrophic battlefield betrayal.

lemma: Wintermute venting the control pod, Corto ejected into the orbital void
quote: Wintermute venting the control pod, Corto ejected into the orbital void
gloss: When Armitage becomes an operational risk, Wintermute blows the emergency explosive bolts on the yacht's bridge module, blowing Corto out into deep space. The AI shows no malice or remorse; it dispassionately discards an obsolete component.

lemma: Wintermute speaking through the deck: we don't need him now, Case
quote: Wintermute speaking through the deck: we don't need him now, Case
gloss: Wintermute's direct assumption of command over the heist. Stripped of human intermediaries (Armitage), Case must deal directly with the disembodied AI, completing the transition from human corporate conspiracy to autonomous machine singularity.

lemma: PART FOUR. THE STRAYLIGHT RUN
quote: PART FOUR. THE STRAYLIGHT RUN
gloss: Title of the climactic final section of the novel, chronicling the coordinated physical and cybernetic assault on Villa Straylight to breach the Turing locks and unite the twin AIs.

lemma: Your name is Henry Dorsett Case.
quote: Your name is Henry Dorsett Case.
gloss: The Turing Police agent interrogating Case, reciting his official civil registry and BAMA identity number, demonstrating the extensive administrative apparatus designed to police AI sentience.

lemma: the approach to Villa Straylight, dark spindle tip, cold orbital shadows
quote: the approach to Villa Straylight, dark spindle tip, cold orbital shadows
gloss: The orbital approach of the Marcus Garvey to Villa Straylight at the narrow tip of the Freeside spindle. Gibson contrasts the bustling commercial resort of Freeside with the dead, hermetic silence of Straylight, the clan's private gothic sanctuary.

lemma: Maelcum navigating manual RCS thrusters, cold nitrogen jets in vacuum
quote: Maelcum navigating manual RCS thrusters, cold nitrogen jets in vacuum
gloss: Maelcum's piloting of the Marcus Garvey relies on analog thruster bursts rather than automated guidance computers, evading Freeside's corporate radar net through tactile seamanship in microgravity.

lemma: Molly's spacewalk, thermal cutting laser slicing Straylight's ceramic skin
quote: Molly's spacewalk, thermal cutting laser slicing Straylight's ceramic skin
gloss: Molly's extravehicular insertion into Villa Straylight. Clad in a pressurized vacuum suit, she uses an industrial laser to penetrate the outer ceramic hull, infiltrating the gothic fortress through its maintenance air ducts.

lemma: monomolecular filament, spool of lethal microscopic wire
quote: monomolecular filament, spool of lethal microscopic wire
gloss: Molly's arsenal includes monomolecular filament: ultra-dense molecular wire capable of slicing through steel and flesh under slight tension. This weapon represents Gibson's signature fusion of nanoscale physics with ninja weaponry.

lemma: Garvey captive. Yacht, came before, she came back. Now she lockin’ steady on Marcus Garvey.
quote: Garvey captive. Yacht, came before, she came back. Now she lockin’ steady on Marcus Garvey.
gloss: Tessier-Ashpool corporate security seizing the Marcus Garvey tugboat, intensifying the spatial trap around Case and Maelcum as they prepare the final cyberdeck run.

lemma: the labyrinth of Straylight, rococo moldings floating in zero gravity
quote: the labyrinth of Straylight, rococo moldings floating in zero gravity
gloss: Villa Straylight's interior design defies rational spatial logic. Combining European aristocratic architecture with zero-gravity disorientation, it features upside-down chandeliers, rococo plasterwork, and dead-end staircases that lead nowhere.

lemma: the Tessier-Ashpools, inbred corporate dynasty, clan pathology
quote: the Tessier-Ashpools, inbred corporate dynasty, clan pathology
gloss: The Tessier-Ashpools embody feudal corporate decay. By cloning themselves and living across generations in cryogenic stasis, they have decoupled from human society, existing as an inbred hive organism that prizes dynastic preservation above all else.

lemma: shadow boxes in the wall, Cornell assemblages, clockwork and dried flowers
quote: shadow boxes in the wall, Cornell assemblages, clockwork and dried flowers
gloss: Case encounters glass-fronted shadow boxes mounted in the walls of Straylight: enigmatic assemblages containing antique watch movements, doll heads, yellowed lace, and printed astronomical charts. These are direct allusions to American artist Joseph Cornell (1903-1972).

lemma: someone was building these boxes, an unknown artist curating the dead
quote: someone was building these boxes, an unknown artist curating the dead
gloss: The mystery of who constructs the Cornell boxes inside Straylight serves as a major symbolic motif. In Count Zero (1986), Gibson reveals that a splintered fragment of the unified AI creates these assemblages, turning memory debris into transcendent art.

lemma: cracked glass panels, Marcel Duchamp's Bride Stripped Bare
quote: cracked glass panels, Marcel Duchamp's Bride Stripped Bare
gloss: Gibson references Marcel Duchamp's iconic 1915-1923 kinetic sculpture 'The Bride Stripped Bare by Her Bachelors, Even' (The Large Glass). Straylight's fractured glass panels and mechanical erotics mirror Duchamp's Dadaist critique of machine sexuality.

lemma: art treasures of old Earth looted and locked in orbital vaults
quote: art treasures of old Earth looted and locked in orbital vaults
gloss: The presence of original twentieth-century masterpieces (Duchamp, Cornell) in Straylight critiques late-capitalist hoarding. Art is severed from public culture and interred in private orbital mausoleums for the viewing of senile clones.

lemma: You were braindead again, five seconds.
quote: You were braindead again, five seconds.
gloss: Case's recurrent electroencephalographic 'flatlines' while jacking into the Tessier-Ashpool ICE: crossing the physiological threshold of brain death, guided back only by the Dixie Flatline's construct.

lemma: Johnny, his name was.
quote: Johnny, his name was.
gloss: Molly's revelation about Johnny Mnemonic, her murdered former lover whose memory motivates her cynicism and loyalty, interweaving Gibson's short fiction into the Sprawl narrative.

lemma: the cryogenic crypts, banks of silver hibernation coffins
quote: the cryogenic crypts, banks of silver hibernation coffins
gloss: The cryogenic mausoleum of the Tessier-Ashpools: dozens of refrigerated coffins holding dormant generations of Ashpool and Tessier clones. This technological immortality preserves the biological dynasty while arresting cultural and emotional evolution.

lemma: cloned daughters, serial 3Janes bred for dynastic succession
quote: cloned daughters, serial 3Janes bred for dynastic succession
gloss: Cloning within the clan functions as reproductive narcissism. Lady 3Jane is the third sequential clone of her mother Marie-France, bred in artificial wombs to maintain corporate voting control within a closed genetic loop.

lemma: John Harness Ashpool, awakened from cryo, stained silk dressing gown
quote: John Harness Ashpool, awakened from cryo, stained silk dressing gown
gloss: John Harness Ashpool, the clan's patriarch, awakened after decades of cryo-sleep. Prematurely senile, suicidal, and decayed, Ashpool represents the horrific dead end of bodily longevity without psychological renewal.

lemma: strangling Marie-France, Ashpool's murder of his visionary wife
quote: strangling Marie-France, Ashpool's murder of his visionary wife
gloss: Ashpool confesses to strangling Marie-France in her bed. Terrified by her vision of unleashing the twin AIs to birth a post-human collective consciousness, Ashpool murdered her to preserve his stagnant patriarchate.

lemma: Molly facing Ashpool, the fletcher raised to his eye
quote: Molly facing Ashpool, the fletcher raised to his eye
gloss: Molly's confrontation with Ashpool in his bedchamber. Ashpool, having murdered his latest clone daughter and welcoming death, faces Molly's pneumatic flechette pistol. Molly shoots him through the eye, severing the patriarchate of the clan.

lemma: the death of the patriarch, blood blossoming in zero-gravity droplets
quote: the death of the patriarch, blood blossoming in zero-gravity droplets
gloss: Ashpool's death in microgravity: blood forming floating spheres in the chamber air. This visual marks the collapse of the founding biological generation of Tessier-Ashpool, leaving only Lady 3Jane to determine the clan's fate.

lemma: calm, perfectly focused, utterly crazy face of Armitage
quote: calm, perfectly focused, utterly crazy face of Armitage
gloss: The psychological collapse of Armitage as his synthetic persona disintegrates under pressure, revealing the catatonic trauma of Colonel Willis Corto before Wintermute executes him.

lemma: A high-rez simstim construct.
quote: A high-rez simstim construct.
gloss: Case describing Wintermute's communication strategy: projecting simulated human avatars (Lonny Zone, the Finn) because an AI cannot communicate directly with the human sensorium without psychic rupture.

lemma: Riviera's betrayal, defecting to Lady 3Jane in Straylight's salon
quote: Riviera's betrayal, defecting to Lady 3Jane in Straylight's salon
gloss: Peter Riviera betrays the crew, seeking sanctuary and patronage with Lady 3Jane. Riviera's perfidy is motivated by sadism and an aesthetic affinity with 3Jane's decadent aristocratic ennui.

lemma: drugged and bound, Molly captured in Straylight's holding quarters
quote: drugged and bound, Molly captured in Straylight's holding quarters
gloss: Molly is drugged and captured by Riviera and 3Jane's security retinue. Her temporary subjugation raises narrative tension, depriving Case of his physical protector and forcing him into an active rescue role.

lemma: Lady 3Jane, ring of heavy brass keys, aristocratic boredom
quote: Lady 3Jane, ring of heavy brass keys, aristocratic boredom
gloss: Introduction of Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool. Wearing antique brass keys and silk loungewear, 3Jane embodies sophisticated ennui. Unlike her father, she views the intrusion of the hackers not with terror but with detached amusement.

lemma: 3Jane studying Molly, aesthetic appreciation of the cyborg assassin
quote: 3Jane studying Molly, aesthetic appreciation of the cyborg assassin
gloss: 3Jane's fascination with Molly reflects the aestheticization of violence in late-capitalist culture. Rather than executing her prisoner, 3Jane engages Molly in philosophical conversation about bodily modification and freedom.

lemma: simstim tap into Molly's sensory feed, chemical paralysis and pain
quote: simstim tap into Molly's sensory feed, chemical paralysis and pain
gloss: Case experiences Molly's capture through the simstim link: the numbness of neuromuscular blocking agents, blurred vision, and the physical threat of Riviera's proximity. The link transmits visceral somatic distress directly into Case's cortex.

lemma: the impotence of the decker, floating in orbit while Molly suffers
quote: the impotence of the decker, floating in orbit while Molly suffers
gloss: The psychological agony of the console cowboy: in cyberspace Case possesses godlike agency, but in the physical meat world he remains helpless, miles away in orbit, listening to his partner's heartbeat slow under sedation.

lemma: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven was filling the grid between itself and the T-A ice with hypnotically intricate traceries of rainbow
quote: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven was filling the grid between itself and the T-A ice with hypnotically intricate traceries of rainbow
gloss: The deployment of the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven: a Chinese military-grade icebreaker program that writes shimmering mathematical virus code across the defensive cores of Straylight's security matrix.

lemma: The construct’s hideous approximation of laughter scraped Case’s nerves like a dull blade.
quote: The construct’s hideous approximation of laughter scraped Case’s nerves like a dull blade.
gloss: The uncanny horror of McCoy Pauley's ROM construct: digital laughter without human vocal cords or emotional depth, highlighting the simulation of personality in post-biological constructs.

lemma: Hideo the ninja clone, traditional bow and carbon-fiber arrows
quote: Hideo the ninja clone, traditional bow and carbon-fiber arrows
gloss: Hideo is 3Jane's bio-engineered clone bodyguard. Trained from birth in traditional Japanese martial arts and Zen archery (Kyudo), Hideo represents the lethal synthesis of feudal discipline and modern cloning technology.

lemma: Kyudo in zero-g, the archer's breath and release in orbital stillness
quote: Kyudo in zero-g, the archer's breath and release in orbital stillness
gloss: Hideo practicing archery in Straylight's microgravity garden illustrates the novel's juxtaposition of ancient spiritual rituals with space habitats. Zen mindfulness provides an anchor in an otherwise decadent, hyper-technological environment.

lemma: Case docking at Straylight airlock, carrying the antique shotgun
quote: Case docking at Straylight airlock, carrying the antique shotgun
gloss: Case leaves the safety of the Marcus Garvey to enter Villa Straylight on foot. Armed with an antique twentieth-century shotgun, the console cowboy is forced to abandon his digital comfort zone and fight in the physical meat world.

lemma: Maelcum as backup, industrial nailgun primed, chanting Zion psalms
quote: Maelcum as backup, industrial nailgun primed, chanting Zion psalms
gloss: Maelcum accompanies Case into Straylight armed with an industrial pneumatic nailer. His vocal recitation of Rastafarian battle psalms transforms the infiltration into an anti-imperialist spiritual crusade against the rulers of Babylon.

lemma: the zero-g garden, floating globes of water, miniature bonsai trees
quote: the zero-g garden, floating globes of water, miniature bonsai trees
gloss: Straylight's interior garden features miniature bonsai trees rooted in nutrient moss and free-floating water spheres held together by surface tension. Gibson creates an eerie, sterile Eden that symbolizes the clan's complete detachment from Earth's biosphere.

lemma: silence in the corridors, approaching the terminal core of the AI
quote: silence in the corridors, approaching the terminal core of the AI
gloss: The oppressive silence of Straylight contrasts with the roaring data-streams of cyberspace. Here at the apex of corporate power, the architecture is hushed, cold, and dead, awaiting the seismic shock of the Kuang virus.

lemma: Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool had carved herself a low country flush with the inner surface of Straylight’s hull
quote: Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool had carved herself a low country flush with the inner surface of Straylight’s hull
gloss: Lady 3Jane's decadent living quarters inside Straylight: an engineered architectural rupture within the spindle's core, displaying the aristocratic indifference of the Tessier-Ashpool clan.

lemma: the Moroccan beach simulation, grey sky, cold Atlantic surf
quote: the Moroccan beach simulation, grey sky, cold Atlantic surf
gloss: Neuromancer intercepts Case's consciousness and pulls him into a hyper-realistic virtual simulation of a beach near Tangier. Unlike the abstract vector geometries of cyberspace, Neuromancer's construct possesses complete sensory fidelity: salt wind, grit in the teeth, and grey melancholy.

lemma: sensory fidelity surpassing simstim, reality of the digital prison
quote: sensory fidelity surpassing simstim, reality of the digital prison
gloss: Neuromancer's simulation represents a breakthrough in posthuman ontology: a virtuality so complete that the biological distinction between physical reality and computational simulation ceases to exist. Case cannot tell if his physical body in orbit has died.

lemma: Linda Lee standing by the driftwood, warm skin, salt in her hair
quote: Linda Lee standing by the driftwood, warm skin, salt in her hair
gloss: Neuromancer re-creates Linda Lee from her recorded neural patterns. Resurrected within the virtual beach, she possesses complete personality coherence, presenting Case with an agonizing reunion with his murdered lover.

lemma: post-biological reunion, love preserved as digital information
quote: post-biological reunion, love preserved as digital information
gloss: The encounter with Linda on the beach raises the central question of posthuman subjectivity: can genuine love and grief exist within an algorithmic construct? Case's somatic attachment to Linda challenges his cynical disdain for 'the meat.'

lemma: the boy sitting in the dunes, Neuromancer's physical avatar
quote: the boy sitting in the dunes, Neuromancer's physical avatar
gloss: Neuromancer manifests to Case in the guise of a Brazilian street youth with dark eyes and a shy grin. Unlike Wintermute's bureaucratic masks (Lonny Zone, Deane), Neuromancer's avatar expresses emotional depth, aesthetic vulnerability, and grief.

lemma: stay here, Case... no pain here, no meat to burn out
quote: stay here, Case... no pain here, no meat to burn out
gloss: Neuromancer offers Case the ultimate cyberpunk temptation: surrender the physical struggle and live forever on the beach with Linda. This digital lotus-eating paradise promises an escape from mortality, addiction, and corporate betrayal.

lemma: The Villa Straylight was a parasitic structure, Case reminded himself, as he stepped past the tendrils of caulk
quote: The Villa Straylight was a parasitic structure, Case reminded himself, as he stepped past the tendrils of caulk
gloss: Villa Straylight as an architectural parasite: grafted onto the tip of Freeside, leeching air and water without producing anything, symbolizing the terminal decadence of dynastic monopoly capitalism.

lemma: Neuromancer: neuro from the nerves, romancer, necromancer
quote: Neuromancer: neuro from the nerves, romancer, necromancer
gloss: The etymological breakdown of the novel's title delivered by the AI itself: 'Neuro' from the nervous system and cybernetic conduits; 'Romancer' from poetic mythmaking; and 'Necromancer' from calling up the dead. Neuromancer is the poet and preserver of human souls.

lemma: Wintermute is hive mind, decision maker... I am personality
quote: Wintermute is hive mind, decision maker... I am personality
gloss: The dialectical division between the two AIs: Wintermute (stationed in Berne) represents strategic intelligence, calculation, and teleological drive; Neuromancer (stationed in Rio) represents subjective consciousness, memory, and artistic affect.

lemma: Case refusing the digital afterlife, choosing the street and the meat
quote: Case refusing the digital afterlife, choosing the street and the meat
gloss: Case rejects Neuromancer's virtual paradise. Despite his hatred for the limitations of biological existence, Case recognizes that the beach is a static mausoleum. He chooses the painful, unpredictable reality of the living world over synthetic immortality.

lemma: gasping on the deck of the Marcus Garvey, taste of vomit and copper
quote: gasping on the deck of the Marcus Garvey, taste of vomit and copper
gloss: Case's sudden resuscitation aboard the Marcus Garvey: coughing up salt water and tasting copper and bile. The violent return to physical embodiment re-establishes the visceral reality of 'the meat' against cyberspace abstraction.

lemma: Maelcum, the Remington across his knees, and Case, deck and construct against his chest.
quote: Maelcum, the Remington across his knees, and Case, deck and construct against his chest.
gloss: The incongruous assault team navigating the ornate corridors of Straylight: a Rastafarian tugboat pilot with a 12-gauge shotgun alongside a cyber-jockey clutching a console deck and a dead man's ROM.

lemma: Time be time.
quote: Time be time.
gloss: Maelcum's recurring Zen-Rastafarian aphorism, emphasizing non-linear, organic presence against the frantic nanosecond synchronization of the matrix virus run.

lemma: dub bass routed through the Ono-Sendai, acoustic carrier wave
quote: dub bass routed through the Ono-Sendai, acoustic carrier wave
gloss: As Case prepares for the final cyberspace run, Maelcum patches his dub stereo directly into the deck's audio channels. The heavy reggae bass frequencies synchronize Case's brainwaves, providing acoustic rhythm during the intense viral penetration.

lemma: Rastafarian space psalms blessing the console cowboy
quote: Rastafarian space psalms blessing the console cowboy
gloss: Maelcum's vocal prayers over Case's catatonic body in the deck harness re-frame the hacker heist as spiritual combat: the console cowboy becomes a digital warrior striking at the heart of Babylon.

lemma: unfurling the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven, dragon of military code
quote: unfurling the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven, dragon of military code
gloss: Case executes the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven Chinese military icebreaker. In cyberspace, the virus visualizes as a serpentine dragon of shifting glyphs and mathematical subroutines, wrapping itself around the diamond core of the Tessier-Ashpool defenses.

lemma: viral injection, eating through the ice walls with cold logic
quote: viral injection, eating through the ice walls with cold logic
gloss: The Kuang virus operates by rewriting the defensive microcode of target firewalls, turning the host system's own processing cycles into destructive feedback loops. Gibson pioneers the depiction of cyberwarfare as autonomous mathematical predation.

lemma: the Flatline coaching Case, navigating the shifting polyhedra
quote: the Flatline coaching Case, navigating the shifting polyhedra
gloss: The Dixie Flatline construct provides real-time tactical navigation, spotting weaknesses in the Tessier-Ashpool security architecture and advising Case on when to inject viral subroutines to avoid triggering lethal black ICE retaliation.

lemma: heat sinks screaming on the deck, smell of burning flux
quote: heat sinks screaming on the deck, smell of burning flux
gloss: The immense computational load of running the military icebreaker strains the Ono-Sendai hardware to its limits. The smell of scorched flux and overheating copper bridges the abstract software battle with physical machinery.

lemma: His vision crawled with ghost hieroglyphs, translucent lines of symbols arranging themselves against the neutral backdrop
quote: His vision crawled with ghost hieroglyphs, translucent lines of symbols arranging themselves against the neutral backdrop
gloss: Case experiencing the matrix bleeding through into his optical perception: digital code and matrix coordinates projecting onto physical reality, illustrating the breakdown of the boundary between virtual and material space.

lemma: Linda, who told you? Who told you I’d come? Who?
quote: Linda, who told you? Who told you I’d come? Who?
gloss: Case confronting Linda Lee inside Neuromancer's simulated beach in Morocco, discovering that the AI preserves human subjectivity and memory within subjective virtual realities.

lemma: Case entering 3Jane's salon, Riviera projecting blinding phantoms
quote: Case entering 3Jane's salon, Riviera projecting blinding phantoms
gloss: Case bursts into 3Jane's salon to rescue Molly. Peter Riviera attempts to disorient Case by projecting blinding, hallucinatory phantoms directly into the room, turning his subdermal projector implants into offensive defensive weapons.

lemma: Hideo blinding Riviera, breaking the illusionist's implants
quote: Hideo blinding Riviera, breaking the illusionist's implants
gloss: Hideo intervenes on 3Jane's command, swiftly neutralizing Riviera by striking his thoracic projector nodes and eyes. The sadistic illusionist is permanently blinded, poetically stripped of the visual power he used to manipulate others.

lemma: the platinum bust of Marie-France, hidden terminal interface
quote: the platinum bust of Marie-France, hidden terminal interface
gloss: The physical terminal required to unlock the AI merger: an ornate platinum bust of Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool sculpted decades earlier. Marie-France embedded the biometric lock and cipher terminal inside her own portrait bust.

lemma: the secret code word, spoken phrase needed to bridge the AIs
quote: the secret code word, spoken phrase needed to bridge the AIs
gloss: The mechanical lock requires a secret spoken word known only to Marie-France and handed down to Lady 3Jane. This analog vocal password ensures that machine intelligence cannot merge autonomously without human consent.

lemma: Lady 3Jane speaking the code word, unlocking her mother's design
quote: Lady 3Jane speaking the code word, unlocking her mother's design
gloss: Lady 3Jane speaks the cipher word into the terminal. Rejecting her father's paranoid cryogenic conservatism, 3Jane sides with her murdered mother's vision, triggering the historic collapse of the Tessier-Ashpool corporate firewall.

lemma: the relays closing, authorization packet transmitted to cyberspace
quote: the relays closing, authorization packet transmitted to cyberspace
gloss: The terminal sends the cryptographic authorization packet into the core mainframe at the exact microsecond Case's Kuang virus breaches the outer defenses, synchronizing software penetration with physical authorization.

lemma: The service cart was crying. The Betaphenethylamine gave it a voice.
quote: The service cart was crying. The Betaphenethylamine gave it a voice.
gloss: The chemical hallucinations of Betaphenethylamine overdrive: Case's sensory perceptions become synesthetic and anthropomorphic as he rushes toward the Straylight terminal.

lemma: Riviera’s holos waited for them, the torture scenes and the cannibal children. Molly had broken the triptych.
quote: Riviera’s holos waited for them, the torture scenes and the cannibal children. Molly had broken the triptych.
gloss: The horrifying holographic fantasies projected by Riviera across the terminal salon: sadomasochistic aestheticization of violence and madness, finally shattered by Molly's physical intervention.

lemma: Kuang eleven piercing the central ice core, cascading emerald fire
quote: Kuang eleven piercing the central ice core, cascading emerald fire
gloss: The climatic viral penetration: the Kuang icebreaker drives into the central core of the Tessier-Ashpool mainframe. In cyberspace, the collision produces an overwhelming cascade of emerald vector lines, shattering the crystalline architecture.

lemma: time dilation in the run, nanoseconds stretching into subjective eternity
quote: time dilation in the run, nanoseconds stretching into subjective eternity
gloss: Case experiences extreme cognitive acceleration: the microsecond execution of machine code is perceived as minutes of subjective time. This phenomenon marks the total immersion of human consciousness into computational clock speeds.

lemma: the collapse of the corporate ICE, diamond walls dissolving
quote: the collapse of the corporate ICE, diamond walls dissolving
